sendEvents.label: Send Events
sendEvents.description: Send [eventName] frames. See "Events" below for details.

removePunctuation.label: Remove Punctuation
removePunctuation.description: Keep only letters, numbers, and spaces, and lowercase everything before sending.

streamedOutput.label: Streamed Output
streamedOutput.description: Send text as it's recognized, instead of when you stop talking.

enableCommands.label: Enable Commands
enableCommands.description: Let the WebSocket relay control this bridge by sending commands. See "Commands" below for details.

wordReplacement.label: Word Replacement
wordReplacement.description: Swap words for replacements before they are sent over the WebSocket. Manage the list in the panel below.

streamConfiguration.label: Stream Configuration
streamConfiguration.description: Send additional copies of the recognized text as separate streams. Configure them in the panel below.

naturalLanguageToolCalling.label: Natural Language Tool Calling
naturalLanguageToolCalling.description: Run recognized text that starts with the wake word through the Needle 3 engine and emit tool call frames. Configure it in the panel below.

wordReplacement.description: Every occurrence of a target word in the voice text is replaced with its replacement before sending. Matching ignores case; the replacement follows the case of the matched word.

streamConfiguration.description: Each enabled stream sends its own copy of the recognized text. The Default Stream is sent as-is and respects "Remove Punctuation". The Original Stream sends the text straight from the model with [stream.orig] in front, ignoring "Remove Punctuation". The Normalized Stream sends the text with punctuation removed (always, regardless of the setting) with [stream.norm] in front. The Translation Stream sends a machine translation of the text with [stream.trans.JP] or [stream.trans.EN] in front, depending on the direction chosen in the Translation panel below.

defaultStream.label: Default Stream
defaultStream.description: The stream with no prefix — what is emitted by default.

originalStream.label: Original Stream
originalStream.description: The model's raw text, untransformed, prefixed with [stream.orig].

normalizedStream.label: Normalized Stream
normalizedStream.description: The text with punctuation removed, prefixed with [stream.norm].

translationStream.label: Translation Stream
translationStream.description: A machine translation of the text, prefixed with [stream.trans.JP] (EN → JP) or [stream.trans.EN] (JP → EN). Configure it in the panel below.

translation.description: The Translation Stream translates the recognized text locally in the browser with OPUS-MT models (run by Transformers.js in a worker). The models are downloaded by the desktop client into its cache folder and served from there — nothing is fetched from the internet during translation, and nothing runs while the direction below is set to Disabled.
translation.directionDescription: EN → JP output goes out as [stream.trans.JP]; JP → EN output as [stream.trans.EN]. The model for the chosen direction is loaded on first use.

naturalLanguageTools.description: Recognized text that starts with the wake word is run through the Needle 3 model (downloaded into the desktop client's cache folder and served from there) together with the tool definitions below. Each successful tool call is emitted as [tool.sep]TOOL_NAME GS KEY=VALUE RS KEY2=VALUE, where GS/RS are the group and record separator control characters. Transcribed text keeps streaming as usual.

wakeWord.label: Wake Word
wakeWord.description: The word to listen for to start tool processing. Messages that don't start with it are ignored.

tools.label: Tools
tools.description: A JSON array of tool definition blocks (OpenAI-style function schemas).

disabledTools.label: Disabled Tools
disabledTools.description: Tool definitions that are disabled and not sent to the model. Tools are moved here and back with the naturalLanguageToolsDisableTool / naturalLanguageToolsEnableTool commands.

confidence.label: Confidence Threshold
confidence.description: A number from 0 to 1. Outputs below this threshold are logged but don't emit tool calls.

items.speechEnded: Sent whenever the user stops speaking.
items.enabled: Sent when transcription has been enabled.
items.disabled: Sent when transcription has been disabled.
items.removePunctuationEnabled: Sent when the punctuation removal feature has been enabled.
items.removePunctuationDisabled: Sent when the punctuation removal feature has been disabled.
items.outputStreamingEnabled: Sent when the output streaming feature has been enabled.
items.outputStreamingDisabled: Sent when the output streaming feature has been disabled.
items.replacementEnabled: Sent when the word replacement feature has been enabled.
items.replacementDisabled: Sent when the word replacement feature has been disabled.
items.naturalLanguageToolsEnabled: Sent when the natural language tool calling feature has been enabled.
items.naturalLanguageToolsDisabled: Sent when the natural language tool calling feature has been disabled.
items.translationEnabled: Sent when the translation feature has been enabled.
items.translationDisabled: Sent when the translation feature has been disabled.

commands.hint: Incoming messages over the WebSocket relay that change how the bridge functions. Only honored while the "Enable Commands" setting is on.

items.toggle: Toggles the microphone on and off.
items.enable: Enables transcription (starts the microphone if needed, otherwise resumes sending frames).
items.disable: Disables transcription (the microphone stays live; no frames are sent until the next enable).
items.removePunctuationToggle: Toggles the punctuation removal on and off.
items.outputStreamingToggle: Toggles the output streaming on and off.
items.replacementToggle: Toggles the word replacement on and off.
items.naturalLanguageToolsToggle: Toggles the natural language tool calling on and off.
items.naturalLanguageToolsEnable: Enables the natural language tool calling.
items.naturalLanguageToolsDisable: Disables the natural language tool calling.
items.naturalLanguageToolsDisableTool: Disables the specific tool with the given name.
items.naturalLanguageToolsEnableTool: Re-enables the specific tool with the given name.
items.naturalLanguageToolsEnableOnlyTools: Enables the given tools, and disables all tools not mentioned.
items.translationToggle: Toggles the Translation Stream on and off.
items.translationDirection: Sets the translation direction (EN → JP, JP → EN, or disabled).
